title: RS 457 Supersport (Explorer Pack)
description: Within the Urban Roadster segment, the Aprilia RS 457 Supersport (Explorer Pack) is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, prioritizing aerodynamic tuck and front-end circuit precision over casual urban commuting.
